about: The site's default cost of casting a vote, and each input's source. Computed by pipeline/intake/cost_assemble.py from the other files in data/cost/.

minutes.what: the median time at the polling place on Election Day 2016 (smartphone measure, includes the time spent voting)
minutes.from: model/MODEL.md section 6 (Chen, Haggag, Pope and Rohla, arXiv 1909.00024)

replication_check.mark: measured (computed from the authors' public file; rounds to the model's 14 and 19 minutes)

hourly_wage.what: Average Hourly Earnings of All Employees, Total Private (Dollars per Hour, Seasonally Adjusted)
hourly_wage.from: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (origin: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Employment Statistics)
hourly_wage.check: FRED's value equals the BLS API's in every month the cache holds (wages.json check_against_bls)

not_measured: time to learn about the contest
child care, lost pay or other costs beyond the minutes valued at the average wage
who_it_applies_to: a voter who votes in person; a mail voter has no line and no trip (mail shares by year: national_mode_shares)

national_mode_shares.note: EAVS counts ballots by the way they were cast (election_day = F1b + F1e; the small remainder is UOCAVA and other); CPS is what citizens say, weighted. The two do not have to agree.

states_with_mail_share_at_least_90_perce: only among states whose EAVS shares are usable that year (see shares_withheld in eavs-mode.json); a state that left its modes blank cannot appear
